pt.p1: A BetterAI é um back-end de IA modular, escrito em Python, que coloca OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini e Groq atrás da mesma interface. Sobre essa base rodam o FastAPI e o Streamlit, que expõem a plataforma em produção.
pt.p2: A plataforma faz hoje o seguinte:
li: Parsing de documentos: converte txt, md, pdf e docx em dados estruturados, conforme o schema de quem chama.
Deep research: busca web profunda via Tavily, devolvida como contexto em markdown.
Base vetorial: ingestão, busca semântica e exclusão no Pinecone.
Embeddings locais: chunking e recuperação em FAISS na memória.
Geração de imagens: o serviço Da-Vinci gera e edita imagens a partir de texto e de referências visuais.

quick.text: Do clone ao primeiro GET /health, em seis passos.

pt.tip: Com a API no ar, a documentação interativa dos endpoints fica em http://localhost:8000/docs.

en.p1: BetterAI is a modular AI back end written in Python that puts OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and Groq behind the same interface. On top of it run FastAPI and Streamlit, which expose the platform in production.
en.p2: Today the platform does the following:
li: Document parsing: turns txt, md, pdf and docx files into structured data, following the caller’s schema.
Deep research: deep web search through Tavily, returned as markdown context.
Vector store: ingestion, semantic search and deletion on Pinecone.
Local embeddings: in-memory chunking and retrieval with FAISS.
Image generation: the Da-Vinci service generates and edits images from text and visual references.

quick.text: From clone to your first GET /health, in six steps.

en.tip: With the API running, the interactive endpoint docs are at http://localhost:8000/docs.

creator.text:
In the AI projects I have built, I noticed a clear gap: there were no solid pillars to support a reliable AI backend. That is what motivated me to create an efficient, secure and scalable architecture designed for companies. My mission is to simplify the complex and deliver real structure to those who want to innovate with AI.

If the project is useful to you, let’s talk.
